prompts.narrative.prose.implication.kind.capital: A restatement that moves the ratio is one the board has to see. | The movement is small in ratio terms and large in what it says about the control. | However small the movement, it is the board's to note. | Any movement in the ratio from a correction is a disclosure, not a rounding. | The size of the movement matters less than the fact that a filed figure moved.

The ratio matters because it is the figure the regulator reads first. | Every change to risk-weighted assets flows straight into this ratio. | This is the number a supervisor compares against the minimum before reading anything else. | A ratio built on an understated denominator overstates the bank's strength.

A treatment that cannot be evidenced from the register is one the regulator will not accept. | Collateral the bank cannot evidence is collateral it cannot count. | The treatment is only as good as the revaluation behind it. | If the register cannot support the treatment, the risk weight is wrong. | An unevidenced treatment understates the capital the book needs.

Materiality decides the route: a material error is restated and notified, not carried into the next return. | Because the error is material, the next return cannot quietly absorb it. | Material means the regulator hears about it from the bank first.
The minimum is the line a restated ratio has to stay above. | Headroom over that floor is what the board is really asking about.

The reason is a data control failure, not a methodology choice, which is why the fix is ownership. | Nothing in the reason is judgement; it is a record nobody kept current. | A stale record, not a policy, is what the restatement corrects.
Approval with a challenge still open is the control question the review has to answer.
The return's status is what the regulator holds the bank to. | A return's status is the bank's public position until it is corrected.
Risk-weighted assets are the denominator every capital ratio is read against. | An error in the denominator is an error in every ratio built on it.
An understatement of that size is why the return had to be restated, not merely annotated. | That is the figure the restatement exists to correct.

The status of the challenge decides whether the treatment it questions can stand. | Where the challenge sits now is what the restatement turns on. | A challenge's status is the control's verdict on the treatment.
